question: What condition affects even the wise one at the tip of nectar with the essence of juice?
premises: The locus is the tip of nectar
The essence of juice is involved
Even the wise one experiences burning
inference: Even the wise one is burned at the tip of nectar by the essence of juice.
uncertainties: The physiological referent of amṛta+agraṃ is not explicit.
plain_english: Even the wise one is burned at the tip of nectar by the essence of the juice.
